name: Corner Fortresses
heights: fields 240 · the middle 210 to 180 · the market 220 · fortress yards 330, ramparts 90 higher · acid lakes 60 deep

theme.ground: lots of cracked, broken concrete between gravel waste ground gone to weeds, rust and oil stains, worn asphalt roads, paved fortress yards with hazard stripes, a brick market square in the middle.
theme.plants: weeds (cycas ferns) in the waste ground.
theme.features: ruined works: armvp, corvp, armlab, corlab and moho wrecks with storage tanks and metal makers round them and rocks30_map rubble; smaller wrecks; crateblue, crateorange, cratered and crateyellow in yards and in the fortresses; minitruck1 and minitruck2 by the roads, cranetruck1 by the market.
theme.weather: brown smog sky, yellow haze; wind 4 to 14; tidal 10; the acid lakes hurt anything in them (water.damage 60, to tune in play).
